RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the December 13, 2004/Agrahayana 22, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Culture; Development of North-Eastern
Region; Heavy Industries  and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development;
Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development; Urban
Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions — 20
Atrocities against women in Kerala
*161. SHRI   A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
SHRI  K.  CHANDRAN
PILLAI:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether the National Commission
for Women has received any complaints
regarding cases of atrocities against women
from Kerala;
(b)  if so, the details thereof, incident-
wise; and
(c) the details of the action taken
thereon?
Languages spoken in the country
*162. SHRIMATI  AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI   SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a)  how many languages are spoken
all over the country as per Government
records;
(b)  whether it is a fact that at the
opening day of  UNESCO 's meet on
"Safeguarding the World's Intangible
Heritage" it was disclosed that the future
of about 80 per cent of the Indian languages
was uncertain; and
(c) if  so, the steps Government propose
to take in order to keep the less spoken
languages alive?
Privatisation of Madarsas and Islamic
education
†*163.SHRI  ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of  HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Madarsas and Islamic
education centres are being privatised; if
so, the reasons therefor;
(b)  whether Government have any
scheme to introduce modern education
system therein;  if so, the  details thereof
and if not,  the reasons therefor; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

49
(c) whether Islamic degree holder
students get the opportunities for
Government services and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Payment of statutory dues of loss
making PSUs
*164. SHRIMATI  S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of  HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES  be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that Government
have taken a decision to give a budgetary
support of Rs. 517 crores to 24 loss making
public sector companies to clean the
outstanding payment of salary and statutory
dues of forty five thousand employees;
(b)  if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
estimated losses of the above 24 public sector
undertakings is now Rs. 1800 crores; and
(d)  if so, the details thereof?
Constitutional status to Minorities
Commission
*165. SHRI  C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of  SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a)  whether there is a proposal to accord
constitutional status to the Minorities
Commission;
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when it would be implemented?
Status of the ICDS
*166. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN :
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government are achieving
slow progress in the implementation of the
Integrated Child Development Scheme for
providing nutritional food to poor children
and establishing of Anganwadi centres; and
(b)  if so, the status of implementation
of the Scheme?
Indo-Pakistan trade talks
*167. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of  COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a)  the nature of trade talks held
between India and Pakistan during SAARC
meeting held recently at Islamabad; and
(b)  the decisions arrived at and the
extent to which the trade between the two
neighbours is expected to improve?
FICCI report on globalisation
†*168. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of  COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the study report namely "Fair
Globalisation" of the Federation of Indian
Chambers of Commerce and Industries;
(b)  if so, whether it is a fact that the
Indian economy has been reported to be
more liberal than that of the economy of
US and Japan; and
(c) if so, Government's  reaction thereto?
Admission guidelines in KVS
*169. SHRI  JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a)  the details of the guidelines issued
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

50
by the KVS governing admission in the
Kendriya Vidyalayas;
(b)  whether these guidelines have been
approved by Government;
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(d)  the criteria or deadline fixed for
calculation whether adequate eligible
children are available or not for admission
in a particular KV in Class 11th, stream-
wise; and
(e)  the steps Government propose to
take to streamline the admission policy of
KVs for Class 11th, stream-wise?
Tribal universities
*170. SHRI  URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government would
consider to establish Tribal universities in
the country including for technical
education; and
(b)  if so,  whether any concrete policy
would  be evolved soon?
Failure of Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan
*171. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government have assessed
the failure of Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan;
(b)  if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that 66 per cent
additional posts of primary teachers are still
lying vacant; if so, the details thereof, State-
wise; and
(d)  the reasons for not filling the
vacancies and the details of the future plan
in this regard?
Allotment of land by Land and
Development Office
*172. SHRI AMAR SINGH : Will the
Minister of  URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government have ordered
a probe into the cases of allotment of land
made by the Land and Development Office
since 1998-99;
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether the Committee probing into
the matter had submitted any report and if
so, the details thereof and if not, by when
it is likely to be submitted?
Vishesh Krishi Upaj Yojana
*173. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of  COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that Government
have introduced a new scheme called
Vishesh Krishi Upaj Yojana through
foreign trade policy with a primary aim to
boost exports of fruits, vegetables and
flowers;
(b)  whether Government are giving any
duty exemption for exporting these
products;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d)  the amount that has been spent on
producing horticulture products during the
last three years, year-wise?
Development of SC/ST/OBC
*174. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD :
Will the Minister of  SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT  be pleased to
state:

51
(a)  whether Government are closely
monitoring the funds inflow from the
States/UTs and the Central Ministries under
the Special Component Plan intended to
achieve overall development of SC/ST/
OBC communities;
(b)  if so, whether the current fund flow
under SCP is in proportion of the
population of SC/ST/OBC in the States;
(c) how many States/UTs, having a
sizeable population of SCs, are setting apart
adequate funds under SCP;
(d)  whether  only 12 Central Ministries/
Departments have formulated the SCP; and
(e)  if so, whether Government would
prevail upon the rest to fall in line?
Projects for NE States
*175. SHRI  MATILAL SARKAR:
Will the Minister of  DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH-EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a)  the projects and their status that
have been undertaken by North Eastern
Regional Agricultural Marketing
Corporation Ltd. in the North Eastern
States;
(b)  the details of the projects set up in
Tripura;
(c) whether  Government are aware that
the pineapple processing project at Nalkata
of Tripura is deteriorating year by year and
the  rate of production is showing
downward trend; and
(d)  if so, the remedial measures taken
in this regard?
India's rank in the World Education
Sector
*176. SHRI  P.K. MAHESHWARI:
SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
 Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a)  the place of India in the World
ranking in the realm of education
currently;
(b)  whether the place of India in the
ranking is continuously sliding
downwards; and
(c) if so,  the details of the action
taken by Government to avoid this
downward slide in the ranking among
the countries of the world in the realm
of education?
Trial of cases under Scheduled Castes
and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of
Atrocities) Act
*177. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH :
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a)  whether exclusive special courts
have been set-up by the Central
Government  and the State Governments
for speedy trial of cases under the
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
(Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989;
(b)  if so, the details thereof, State-wise
including Andhra Pradesh;
(c) the number of cases filed, the
percentage of pendency and convictions,
State-wise as on date; and
(d)  the reasons for the low percentage
of convictions?
Notice on  land sanctioned to Escorts
Hospital
*178. SHRI  MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of  URBAN
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether DDA has served notice to
the Escorts hospital authorities in
connection with the land originally
sanctioned to the hospital;

52

(b)  if so,  the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the response of the hospital
authorities thereto; and
(d) Government's reaction thereto?
Heavy industries in Himachal Pradesh
†*179.SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR : Will
the Minister of  COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that in spite of
availability of electricity  in huge
quantity, comparatively peaceful
environment and also having favourable
conditions for heavy industry in
Himachal Pradesh,  Government have not
established any heavy industry in the
State so far;
(b)  if so,  whether Government would
consider to set up any heavy industry in
the State, keeping in view the above
favourable conditions; and
(c) if so, the blue print thereof and if
not, the reasons therefor?
Job opportunities
*180. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA : Will
the Minister of  URBAN EMPLOYMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether the number of educated
unemployed and uneducated job-seekers in
urban cities has grown across the country;
(b)  the city-wise details of post-
graduate, graduate, under-graduate and ITI
qualified job-seekers, skilled and unskilled
unemployed labourers in various age-
groups as on 1st January of year 1991,
1992, 1995, 1996, 1998, 2000, 2002 and
2004 duly indicating their percentage vis-
a-vis population in the respective years;
(c) the details of job-seekers secured
employment in respective categories during
the relevant years;
(d)  the estimated population of job-
seeking youth by 2010;
(e)  the measures contemplated, if any,
for achieving quantum enhancement in job
opportunities; and
(f)  the time-frame thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

RAJYA   SABHA
—————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the December 13, 2004/Agrahayana 22, 1926 (Saka)
—————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Culture; Development of North-Eastern
Region; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Human Resource
Development; Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice;
Parliamentary  Affairs;   Social  Justice  and  Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Urban Development; Urban Employment and
Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions — 155
220
Foreign Trade Policy
†995. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the salient features of the New
Foreign Trade Policy introduced from
September, 2004;
(b) whether it has been proposed to
provide relaxations to export-oriented units
to increase employment opportunities
therein under the said trade policy; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
 Export of steel to
Pakistan
996. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India Steel
Alliance has urged Government to promote
steel exports to Pakistan; and
(b) if so, the current statistics of export
of this commodity to Pakistan and the
future action plan to boost the exports?
 Allocation of quota for import of oil
997. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India's top edible oil
companies use oil imported by the State
Trading Corporation under the Annual
Preferential Import Quota;
(b) whether the Director General of
Foreign Trade (DGFT) allocates quota for
import of oil to the agencies;
(c) whether the DGFT had short-
circuited the process of equitable allocation
of the quota by allocating the entire quota
to STC; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Patent Amendment Bill
998. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
modify the Patent Act during the Winter
Session of Parliament;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

221
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are aware that
there are a lot of apprehensions in the
domestic pharmaceutical and chemical
sectors about the proposed amendments;
and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
to address those apprehensions?
 Concerns of drug industry on
patents law
999. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the drug industry has
represented concerns against the patent law
formulated recently by the competent
authority;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the above concerns have
been rectified;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(e) whether a high level independent
Commission would be initiated to make
recommendations on the patent issues?
 Trade between India and
China
†1000. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the turn-over of export and import
trade between India and China during the
last three years, year-wise;
(b) the commodities exported to China;
and
(c) the amount of revenue earned there-
from?
 Increase in exports to China
†1001. SHRI PY ARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that exports from
India to China have increased during the
last two years;
(b) if so, the commodities whose exports
have increased;
(c) whether any proposal has been
received from China to enhance the bilateral
trade; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Indo-Pak talks on trade and
economic cooperation
1002. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether two day Indo-Pak Secretary
level talks were held in Islamabad in the
month of August, 2004 on trade and
economic cooperation;
(b) if so, the points and subjects
discussed;
(c) whether any agreement was signed
between the two countries;
(d) if so, the details thereof and to what
extent trade between the two countries
would be improved further; and
(e) whether Pakistan's tea industry
wants free deal?
 Export of substandard goods
1003. SHRI SU. THIRUNAVUK-
KARASAR:
SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

222
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have issued
any direction to the ports to prepare a list
of exporters who have been charged with
exporting substandard goods;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have received
any list from the ports;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken thereon?
 World Bank report on FCI
†1004. SHRI RAM
JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the World Bank's report
namely 'Doing Business';
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that the
report enumerated the reasons for which
foreign capital investment is not being
encouraged;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) Government's reaction thereto?
 Export Transaction Cost
†1005. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the export
transaction cost is more in India than that
of the other countries especially Japan,
European countries, USA and England;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
current year; and
(c) the reasons therefor?
 Export of major Commodities to
Pakistan
1006. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that export of
India's seven major commodities-iron ore,
iron and steels, plastic products, sugar,
machinery and instruments, residual
chemicals and spices to Pakistan declined
by 50 per cent to US $  30 million during
2002-03;
(b) the reasons for the negative export
growth; and
(c) the measures Government are taking
or propose to take to increase its exports
to Pakistan during the current year and in
the coming years?
 Infrastructure improvement to boost
exports
1007. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose special policies to increase private
investment in ports, railways etc., in a bid
to improve infrastructure facilities in the
country so as to achieve the export target
of 21 per cent; and
(b) how exactly the scheme 'ASIDE'
work in the States for boosting exports and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

223
equity participation in infrastructure
projects?
 Production of cigarettes and bidis
1008. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
cigarettes and bidis are being produced in
various States, illegally and without having
proper license;
(b) if so, the details of such illegal
producers; and
(c) the steps Government have taken or
propose to take to curb the illegal
manufacturing of cigarettes and bidis?
 Export Credit Guarantee Corporation
1009. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
raise the capital of Export Credit Guarantee
Corporation (ECGC) from Rs. 500 crore
to Rs. 800 crore; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
 Export target
1010. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have export
target of US $ 150 billion for the financial
year 2009-10;
(b) if so, the basis of this export target
set by Government;
(c) whether Government have made any
plans for increasing rice exports during the
next five years;
(d) whether any specific plan has been
drawn up for agricultural exports; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Rise in exports
1011. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that exports have
crossed US dollars 40 billion during the
period from April 1 to October 30, 2004;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that the
growth of exports during this seven month
period increased nearly 27 per cent over
the same period last year;
(c) to what extent the traditional exports
like tea, jute, etc. have not kept pace with the
overall rate of growth of  27 per cent; and
(d) the steps taken to give a boost to
traditional exports?
 Focus of the New Foreign Trade
Policy
1012. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is the thrust of the New
Foreign Trade Policy (NFTP), which
proposes to replace the existing Export-
Import (EXIM) policy;
(b) the details of the strategy that has
been worked out under this new frame-
work to double the  exports of goods and
services; and
(c) the details of the incentives and
facilities that are proposed to be given to
the industry to boost the exports?
 SAARC Conference
1013. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the recently
concluded SAARC Conference, he had
called on the SAARC nations to build a

224
strong framework of regional economic
cooperation which should be workable and
programme based; and
(b) if so, the response of the SAARC
countries thereto?
 Import of elementary mercury
1014. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the import of elementary
mercury has increased manifold during the
last few years;
(b) if so, the details of imports during
the last three years; and
(c) the names of industries who are
importing mercury and whether mercury
is being used as consumer product and if
so, the reasons therefor?
 India International Trade Fair
1015. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of visitors in the
International Trade Fair held from
November 14, 2004 this year;
(b) whether it is a fact that adequate
arrangements were not made for their
comfort and conveniences;
(c) the reason for the inability of the
ITPO to make adequate arrangements;
(d) how Government propose to deal
with increasing crowds at this trade fair
site;
(e) whether the trade fair would be held
twice every year; and
(f) the details of the alternative plans
being considered by ITPO in this regard?
 Special Economic Zone in
Kerala
1016. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have accorded
sanction to set up a Special Economic Zone
(SEZ) at Kochi in Kerala;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what are the stipulations specified
in the New Foreign Trade Policy relating
to development of the towns of export
excellence and the towns of Kerala, where
the concerned sectors achieved the cross
mark?
Indo-Chinese trade relations
1017. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are willing to
build a long term and sustainable economical
relation with China as India has emerged
number one trading partner replacing Japan
in the North-Eastern Region;
(b) if so, whether China's decision to
give India approved destination status for
tourism purpose would help in availing
information gap existing between the two
countries;
(c) if so, to what extent both India and
China have agreed to improve their trade
relations; and
(d) the agreements reached between the
two countries?

225
 Raw material exports
1018. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the exports of raw
materials like iron ore, cotton, tobacco and
minerals like Bauxite during the three years;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
scale down exports of raw materials and in
their place export more finished or
processed products;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Subsidy Based Export Policy
1019. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have formulated a new private sector
subsidy based export policy to ensure that
India does not suffer from excessive out
flow of wheat and rice;
(b) if so, the salient features thereof;
and
(c) what is the difference between the
Open Door Export Policy and Subsidy-
Based Export Policy?
 Import of tea waste
1020. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
several tea exporters from India have been
importing tea waste from Indonesia and
other countries and re-exporting them as
orthodox variety;
(b) whether Libya has recently rejected
a huge consignment of tea from India as
sub-standard;
(c) if so, whether the certificate of origin
for this consignment was issued by Jodhpur
Chamber of Commerce rather than Tea
Board; and
(d) whether Government would
consider appointing Tea Board as the sole
inspection agency for tea exports from the
country?
 Foreign investment in SEZ
1021. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA MURTHY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
woo foreign investors to set up Special
Economic Zones by raising the FDI cap to
100 per cent;
(b) whether the proposal includes bio-
technology parks and other Free Trade and
Warehousing Zones; and
(c) if so, the features thereof?
 Indo-China Trade
1022. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Sino-Indian trade is set to
cross  $ 10 billion mark this year for the
first time;
(b) if so, whether India determines to
further diversify and strengthen bilateral
ties between the two countries;
(c) if so, whether according to India, its
efforts are to increase trade and economic
relationship with China;
